Frequently Asked Questions

Q. I want to donate instead of subscribing, will this count towards this wall?

A. Yes! Every 5 USD donated to Fender/Rednef will be treated as a month on this board (ie. your first 50 USD will put you on the novice tier).

Q. How do I go about donating?

A. You can donate via shinies on Fender or Rednef's page. Changes could take up to an hour to appear below and only the donations since midnight pacific time on 1st of the current month will apply.

Q. I would like my name not to be visible on this page but still show off my FA+ badge. Is there a way to do that?

A. Yes! Under Account Settings, scroll down to "Privacy settings" and toggle "Wall of Awesome visibility" to your desired setting.
